# FOREO

> > FOREO is a Swedish beauty-tech company offering pro-level skincare and oral care devices powered by innovative technologies like microcurrent, LED light therapy, and sonic pulse technology.

FOREO specializes in at-home beauty devices combining clinical efficacy with Swedish design. The product portfolio spans facial cleansing, anti-aging treatments, hair care, oral hygiene, and body sculpting, all featuring proprietary technologies like T-Sonic™ and Anti-Shock System™.
